answer: Use synchronized attendance tickets. First, open staffed booths worldwide for one shared ten-minute window. Second, keep each attendee inside until closing and issue one blind-signed ticket; each booth is an inlet for one identity. Third, redeem each ticket once for an epoch key, tying subsequent actions to one thread. Fourth, expire the keys at the next ceremony. With recruits paid $20 each per ceremony, 1,000 fake identities require 1,000 people and $20,000 every epoch, before travel costs. It is like floating timber through a lock with a separate chamber for every log.
